title: Change a vehicle registration
summary: This page provides information on how to change various details related to a vehicle registration.

internal_links.text: Change the details on a vehicle registration
Change the business name or usage on a vehicle registration
Change the manager details on a vehicle registration
Change the details of your garaging address (individual)

faqs.q: What details can I change on a vehicle registration?
faqs.a: You can change the details on a vehicle registration, the business name or usage, or the manager details. You can also change the details of your garaging address (individual).
